questions.question: What new service has Elon Musk's X (formerly Twitter) recently added as part of its 'everything app' strategy, allowing users to hold deposits and send peer-to-peer payments?
questions.explanation: Elon Musk's social media platform X (formerly Twitter) has launched banking services as part of its ambition to become an 'everything app.' This new feature, called 'X Money,' allows users to hold deposits, send peer-to-peer payments, pay bills, transfer money by wire, and mail checks.
questions.background: The move signifies X's broader strategy to integrate various functionalities beyond social networking, following a trend seen in apps like WeChat in China that offer a wide array of services including communication, payments, and e-commerce.
questions.examRelevance: X (formerly Twitter) has launched 'X Money' for banking services.

source.title: Elon Musk's X adds banking in 'everything app' push

questions.question: Which country advised its citizens to leave the Middle East due to rising tensions with Iran?
questions.explanation: The United States advised its citizens to leave the Middle East, citing rising tensions with Iran and warning that Iran was unpredictable. This advisory reflects the escalating geopolitical situation in the region.
questions.background: Tensions between the US and Iran have been high, with ongoing discussions about a potential deal and threats of strikes. Such travel advisories are issued by governments to protect their citizens in regions facing significant security risks.
questions.examRelevance: United States = Advised citizens to leave Middle East due to Iran tensions.

source.title: US tells Americans to leave Middle East

questions.question: Which three districts in Assam, historically less affected by floods, have recently borne the brunt of the annual phenomenon?
questions.explanation: The three districts in Assam that have recently borne the brunt of severe flooding, despite historically being less affected, are Charaideo, Jorhat, and Sivasagar. These areas faced unexpected and extensive inundation.
questions.background: While floods are an annual occurrence in many parts of Assam, the unusual severity in these specific districts highlights changing flood patterns or increased vulnerability, drawing attention to regional disaster preparedness.
questions.examRelevance: Charaideo, Jorhat, and Sivasagar are the three Assam districts recently most affected by floods.

source.title: Why have three Assam districts borne the brunt of floods | Explained

questions.question: Which political party recently witnessed an escalation in infighting, with a camp led by Ritabrata Banerjee reportedly taking control of its headquarters and staking claim for the party with the Election Commission?
questions.explanation: The Trinamool Congress (TMC) recently experienced an escalation in internal conflict, with a faction led by Ritabrata Banerjee reportedly taking control of the party headquarters. This camp also met the Election Commission in Delhi to stake claim for the party.
questions.background: Political parties occasionally face internal dissent and power struggles, which can sometimes lead to factions attempting to assert control over party symbols, assets, and official recognition. Such disputes often involve appeals to the Election Commission of India.
questions.examRelevance: Trinamool Congress infighting escalated with Ritabrata Banerjee's camp taking control of party headquarters.

source.title: Trinamool infighting escalates as Ritabrata-led camp ‘takes control’ over party headquarters

questions.question: Tamil Nadu has recently earmarked a ₹50 crore revolving fund for disaster preparedness and announced the establishment of the Tamil Nadu State Disaster Management Institute at what estimated cost?
questions.explanation: Tamil Nadu has recently earmarked a ₹50 crore revolving fund to enhance disaster preparedness. Additionally, the state announced the establishment of the Tamil Nadu State Disaster Management Institute at an estimated cost of ₹55 crore.
questions.background: These initiatives are part of Tamil Nadu's broader strategy to strengthen its resilience against natural calamities, which frequently affect the coastal state. A dedicated institute and revolving fund will improve emergency response and long-term risk reduction efforts.
questions.examRelevance: Tamil Nadu earmarked ₹50 crore revolving fund for disaster preparedness and established the State Disaster Management Institute at ₹55 crore.

source.title: Tamil Nadu earmarks ₹50 crore revolving fund for disaster preparedness: Minister
